summary: Allarity Therapeutics filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement terminating its $6,000,000 equity line of credit with Tumim Stone Capital, effective October 28, 2026. The filing states that no further primary shares will be offered or sold under the January 28, 2026 Common Stock Purchase Agreement or the original prospectus supplement, while resale coverage for previously issued shares remains intact and the Form S-3 registration statement is not withdrawn. No price, premium, stake, or advisor terms are disclosed. The structural note is a removal of a standby dilutive financing channel; risk-arb focus shifts to the company's remaining liquidity and alternative funding needs.
